title: HNK health workers’ general strike over collective agreement and wage coefficient
status: The strike began on 10 Dec, was interrupted by a court order on 15 Dec and permitted to resume by the 22 Dec ruling; RFE reported a 5 Jan Mostar public march by several hundred. The December report documents a press conference but does not establish a 50+ street gathering during December; the January count is out-of-month and cannot be imputed backward.
notes: Government of HNK was the collective-agreement target. Preserve the strike as labor continuity; do not treat regional workforce totals as a local demonstration count.

title: Residents guard Bihać’s Bira site against return/relocation of migrants
status: RFE reports residents were guarding Bira daily on 24 Dec and quotes one individual who said he had guarded for 81 days; a resident group size or 50+ public gathering is not established. The source describes opposition to a proposed government return/relocation, but the event’s public-demonstration character remains unresolved.
notes: This is separate from the migrant roadblock. Do not attribute it to intercommunal violence or infer turnout from the camp population.
